definitions.gloss: taking a course; attending a lecture
definitions.explanation: The act of enrolling in and attending a course, lecture, or training program. A formal term commonly used in educational and professional training contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦{講座|こうざ}→講座：09790_kouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受講|じゅこう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I am taking an online course.

examples.japanese: {受講|じゅこう}⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧です。
examples.english: Registration for the course is until next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧、⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受講|じゅこう}し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: All new employees must take the safety training course.

notes:
USAGE:
{受講|じゅこう} is a formal term for attending lectures or courses. It is more formal than simply saying ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to take a class) and is preferred in official contexts like university course registration or corporate training.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受講|じゅこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to take a course)
- {受講|じゅこう}{者|しゃ} (course participant, attendee)
- {受講|じゅこう}{料|りょう} (course fee)
- {受講|じゅこう}⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧ (course registration)
- {受講|じゅこう}⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧ (certificate of completion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{聴講|ちょうこう} means to audit a course (attend without credit), while {受講|じゅこう} implies formal enrollment.
